name: Single-pass GPU Solid Voxelization
definition: A GPU-based algorithm to voxelize solid geometry in a single pass, producing point-sampled or over/under-conservative results.
summary: Single-pass GPU Solid Voxelization voxizes watertight 3D models into binary volumes in one pass using XOR accumulation and bitwise masks, distinguishing itself from boundary voxelization by filling all interior voxels.
